question:
Which of the following statement regarding the moon is correct?

I. The size of the illuminated part of the moon visible from the Earth increases each day after the new moon day.

II. After the full moon day, the sunlit part of the moon visible from the Earth decreases in size every day.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II.**__

• Moon doesn't have its light. Hence, we can see only that part of the Moon that's illuminated by the Sun.
